Siemens 1500 PLC Key Features at a Glance

Siemens 1500 PLC is the flagship controller of the SIMATIC S7 family, programmed in TIA Portal and built for larger, faster and more complex automation than the S7-1200. It uses a modular architecture, scales to thousands of I/O points through remote I/O on PROFINET, and adds programming languages, redundancy and safety options that the compact S7-1200 does not offer.

FeatureSiemens S7-1500
ArchitectureModular, with ET200MP, ET200SP and ET200PRO I/O systems
I/O capacityThousands of points through remote I/O
Programming languagesLAD, FBD, SCL, plus STL and GRAPH
PerformanceUp to about 8 times faster than the S7-1200 on top models
RedundancyCPU redundancy with the CPU 1515R-2
FieldbusPROFINET native, PROFIBUS DP on select CPUs
SafetyUp to SIL 3 and PLe with safe motion on F-CPUs
MotionT-CPUs for multi axis synchronisation, camming and kinematics
Engineering softwareStep 7 Professional in TIA Portal

When the S7-1500 Is the Right Choice

  1. The plant needs many machines or a whole line coordinated by one controller.
  2. The I/O count is well above about 100 points or is expected to grow.
  3. Batch or sequence logic is easier to write in GRAPH.
  4. Legacy PROFIBUS DP devices must stay on the network.
  5. A continuous process cannot accept controller downtime, so CPU redundancy is needed.

Code written for an S7-1200 usually moves up to an S7-1500 with little change, so many engineers learn on the smaller CPU first.
